title_cyr: Море расти, расти ти малој моме
title_latin: More rasti, rasti ti maloj mome
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: A shape-shifting chase song. 'јаска' is my reading of 'I myself'; the last stanzas say 'lets fly' of a fish, which is in the original and rendered literally. Origin unclear, looks traditional.

words_to_learn.en: I myself (dialect, 'јас ќе' blend, my reading)
